name: En Nahud

queries.query: En Nahud Sudan official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: Discovery found the official Sudan National Spatial Portal, which advertises WMS/WFS map services, and Sudan Judiciary land-registration material. No publicly accessible En Nahud parcel-vector endpoint, native parcel-ID schema, or safe parcel geometry response was identified.

queries.query: النهود السودان خريطة كادستر قطع الأراضي السجل العقاري
queries.result: البحث العربي أثبت وجود بوابة السودان المكانية ومواد إدارة تسجيلات الأراضي التابعة للسلطة القضائية، لكنه لم يكشف خدمة عامة مجهولة للوصول إلى مضلعات قطع الأراضي في النهود أو مخططاً آمناً يربط معرفاً أصلياً بالهندسة.

officialSourceAssessment.nationalCustodian: Sudan National Spatial Portal is presented by the National Information Center as a national spatial map portal with OGC WMS/WFS services. Sudan Judiciary publishes the land-registration administration and procedures.
officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: No directly evidenced En Nahud or West Kordofan local registry office map/API was found in the executed discovery.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official National Information Center page described the Sudan National Spatial Portal and stated that it provides OGC WMS/WFS services; the page did not expose a parcel layer URL or schema.

Anonymous HTTPS request timed out after 20 seconds during DNS/connection resolution. No login, credential, token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was attempted; no absence inference was made.

Official Judiciary page described the General Land Registrations administration and nationwide registration oversight; it exposed procedure prose, not an anonymous parcel-vector service or En Nahud geometry.

Official-looking Aqari real-estate service landing page returned HTTP 502 from the anonymous request. Search material describes national land-registration services, but no parcel API or safe geometry was obtained.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: The official portal description was reachable, but the linked geoportal itself timed out before current JavaScript/configuration could be inspected.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: The exact WUP point [12.6900568233347, 28.4212621930496] was preserved in latitude/longitude order. No coordinate shift or parcel query was used.
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was available because no usable public parcel endpoint was exposed and the official geoportal timed out.
